name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 1 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 1a. Recalls that the principles of conferral, subsidiarity and proportionality must be fully respected and that the European Democracy Shield must not result in an unjustified transfer of competences from the Member States to the EU or an expansion of Commission powers beyond those conferred by the Treaties; stresses the need to preserve the institutional balance established by the Treaties;
